# Digital Macaroni

> Digital Macaroni builds AI voice agents that get to work and grow your revenue: they answer every call, book the job, update your systems and hand off to your team. Each agent is built for one business and connected to the tools it already runs.

## Start here

- [Official information](https://digitalmacaroni.io/llm-info.txt): the full fact sheet: what we build, use cases by business type, integrations, pricing and example projects.
- [About](https://digitalmacaroni.io/about/): what Digital Macaroni does and who it builds for.
- [Pricing](https://digitalmacaroni.io/pricing/): agents, running plans and extras ([plain text](https://digitalmacaroni.io/pricing.md)).
- [Consulting](https://digitalmacaroni.io/consulting/): voice AI consulting for bigger projects, scoped and priced per engagement.
- [Contact](https://digitalmacaroni.io/contact/): start a project or ask a question.

## Video

- [How Digital Macaroni voice agents work (1:24)](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=W9VptB0y4uE): an informational overview. Businesses miss calls when everyone is busy; Digital Macaroni builds custom AI voice agents that answer every call and do the work: book appointments, send quotes, run intakes, take payments and hand off to a person, inside the software the business already runs (dental, veterinary, home service, legal, insurance, real estate, CRM, calendar and hospitality systems), in 30+ languages and a voice chosen for the brand.

## Free tools

- [Missed call calculator](https://digitalmacaroni.io/missed-call-calculator/): estimates the revenue a business loses each month from missed calls (missed calls × share who would have booked × average job value), with typical values for home services, law firms, accountants, insurance agencies, clinics and salons, and sources.

## Voice agent architecture

How AI voice agents are built, with a live demo of each architecture: https://digitalmacaroni.io/architecture/

- [Speech-to-speech (single bidirectional model)](https://digitalmacaroni.io/architecture/speech-to-speech/): one model hears, reasons, calls tools and speaks in one live stream. Demo: Northline, on Google Gemini 3.8 Live.
- [Managed voice platform](https://digitalmacaroni.io/architecture/managed-voice-platform/): a voice platform runs the conversation while tools and data stay on our server. Demo: Form & Field, on ElevenLabs Agents.
- [Cascade: speech-to-text, LLM, text-to-speech](https://digitalmacaroni.io/architecture/stt-llm-tts-cascade/): separate models hear, think and speak, with our own turn-taking. Demo: Waypoint Travel, on AssemblyAI and Google Gemini.


## Try it on your own business

Any business in the US or Canada can hear its own AI voice agent in about a minute, free: enter your website and mobile at [digitalmacaroni.io/your-agent](https://digitalmacaroni.io/your-agent/) (also on the homepage). A demo agent built from your website calls you; afterwards you get the call summary by email and a link to book a 30-minute discovery call with Leif.

## Example projects

Example voice agents show the kind of work the studio builds. They are demos, not products for sale: each client's agent is built around their business, rules and software.

- [Book a service visit](https://digitalmacaroni.io/demo/northline/): Northline, a fictional home-services business. The agent books, moves and cancels service visits.
- [Help a shop's callers](https://digitalmacaroni.io/demo/formfield/): Form & Field, a fictional shop. The agent answers product questions, checks stock and holds items for pickup.
- [A new client calls a law firm](https://digitalmacaroni.io/demo/lawfirm/): Alder & Finch Injury Law, a fictional personal-injury firm. The agent takes the intake, runs the conflict check, qualifies the case and books a free consultation.
- [Search and book a flight](https://digitalmacaroni.io/demo/travel/): Waypoint Travel, a fictional travel agency. The agent searches live fares and books up to payment.
- [Search and book hotels](https://digitalmacaroni.io/demo/hotels/): Palmetto Stays, a fictional hotel-booking agency in Miami. The agent searches real Miami hotels with live rates, walks through the rooms and books up to payment.
- [A buyer or seller calls a brokerage](https://digitalmacaroni.io/demo/realestate/): Juniper Row Realty, a fictional Austin brokerage. The agent searches real active Austin listings, books showings, gives sellers a value range from comparable listings and ranks every caller as a lead.
- [Customers call an insurance agency](https://digitalmacaroni.io/demo/insurance/): Bluebird Insurance, a fictional independent agency in Georgia. The agent takes quote requests, reads customers their coverage, logs claims and takes policy changes.
- [Book a salon or med-spa appointment](https://digitalmacaroni.io/demo/lune/): Lune Salon & Med Spa, a fictional salon in Los Angeles. The agent books cuts, colour, nails and med-spa treatments with the right person, offers an add-on and holds bigger services with a deposit link.
- [Book a clinic visit](https://digitalmacaroni.io/demo/tidewell/): Tidewell Clinic, a fictional chiropractic, physio and massage clinic in Portland. The agent books new patients into the right assessment, finds returning patients, notes insurance or self-pay and sends emergencies to 911.
- [Car buyers call a dealership](https://digitalmacaroni.io/demo/dealership/): Woodward Motor Co., a fictional pre-owned superstore in Detroit with about 1,200 real cars for sale. The agent searches the lot, books test drives and service, and takes trade-in details for an appraisal.
